prTitle: feat(workflow_engine): Add in hook for producing occurrences from the stateful detector
head: 8422030ef456e3a898415e96475b4d8ddfc7640f

tps.bug: MetricAlertDetectorHandler inherits from StatefulDetectorHandler but only contains pass, failing to implement its required abstract methods: counter_names (property), get_dedupe_value(), get_group_key_values(), and build_occurrence_and_event_data(). This will cause a TypeError at runtime when the class is instantiated.
tps.evidenciaOpus: grouptype.py:11-12 makes MetricAlertDetectorHandler a StatefulDetectorHandler with only `pass`; StatefulDetectorHandler declares abstract counter_names, get_dedupe_value, get_group_key_values and build_occurrence_and_event_data (processors/detector.py:142-170), so Detector.detector_handler (models/detector.py:86) raises TypeError when instantiating it for metric alert detectors.
tps.evidenciaAstra: src/sentry/incidents/grouptype.py:11-12 replaces the concrete handler with an empty StatefulDetectorHandler subclass, leaving the abstract members at src/sentry/workflow_engine/processors/detector.py:142-170 unimplemented. src/sentry/workflow_engine/models/detector.py:86 instantiates the registered handler directly, so metric-alert handler construction now raises TypeError; this is an introduced bug.

tps.bug: Wrong value `6` passed for `group_2` occurrence — the data packet specifies `"group_2": 10`. Should be `10` to accurately reflect the test scenario, which will ensure the test produces the correct occurrence data.
tps.evidenciaOpus: test_detector.py:244 build_mock_occurrence_and_event takes `value` but never uses it, and it also implements MockDetectorStateHandler.build_occurrence_and_event_data (line 39); test_state_results_multi_group builds group_2's expected occurrence with 6 (line 191) while the packet has 10 (line 177) and still passes, so value forwarding to the new hook is never verified.
tps.evidenciaAstra: tests/sentry/workflow_engine/processors/test_detector.py:244-275 never uses value, and the mock hook delegates to this helper at line 39. The multi-group test supplies 10 at line 177 but builds its expectation with 6 at line 191, so its occurrence assertions cannot detect incorrect measurement forwarding through the newly added hook; this is a test_gap.
